title: Primary Logo with Background / Signage example
slide_intent: Test a mark in its physical setting because recognition depends on distance, angle and surrounding light.
strategic_value: The bright backed logo can make a roadside Burger King sign identifiable against the sky.
demonstration: A full-page photograph shows an elevated rounded burger-shaped sign from below against blue sky and a white cloud.
practical_value: Compare the backed logo’s visibility and edge separation on a freestanding sign.

content_islands.name: Elevated sign
content_islands.spec: Place the large sign left of center, angled upward on a metal pole with its white perimeter visible.

content_islands.name: Sky and cloud
content_islands.spec: Let the sky fill the remaining field so the sign’s silhouette and contrast can be judged.

reference_purposes.Expression: Orange buns, red lettering and a light backing remain visible on the photographed sign.
reference_purposes.Application: The logo is shown on a fabricated elevated outdoor sign.
